claim: The public HERCULES protocol describes ToleDYNAMIC, an 80-participant immunological substudy spanning HERCULES and PERSEUS (about 40 participants from each) with samples at baseline, month 3, and month 12; planned measurements include B-cell and CD14-monocyte RNA sequencing in a subset, detailed lymphocyte/monocyte phenotyping, CD64 and other monocyte-state markers, cytokines, myelin phagocytosis, reactive oxygen species, and Seahorse metabolic assays linked to parent-trial clinical and MRI data.
future_grounding_route: Ask Sanofi/Vivli whether ToleDYNAMIC data, separate SAP, data dictionary, parent-trial linkage, arm assignment, raw RNA counts, flow cytometry, and functional-assay outputs are available. Freeze a treatment-by-time analysis before values are viewed; if placebo participants were not sampled or selection was outcome-dependent, restrict interpretation to descriptive paired change.

project_finding_reference.finding_id: The next rational computation requires longitudinal progression-treatment molecular data

project_use: Highest-priority controlled-data acquisition target because it could directly test pre-existing APC/HLA-II, CD64, lysosomal, MIF, metabolic, and resolution modules under a progression-treatment intervention. Existence in a protocol does not establish completion, access, arm balance, assay quality, or a treatment effect.
relationship_note: The planned substudy overlaps unusually well with project-grounded module questions, but no ToleDYNAMIC result is integrated and no project route is upgraded until controlled data are obtained and rerun under a frozen plan.
